reviews.text: Very happy to have picked this clinic for my two kitten's first appointments. Made picking a forever Veterinarian VERY easy when they provide such exceptional service and care. Will definitely be coming here for all needs in the future.
Kenly, their receptionist, was extremely rude and hostile over the phone regarding transparency for costs of care.

The entire team at Dallas Veterinary Clinic goes above and beyond to genuinely care for my dog. Dr. Cahill is incredibly knowledgeable and takes the time to answer my questions and explain her recommendations thoroughly. Every staff member we have interacted with has treated both me and my dog with kindness, patience, and respect. My dog loves going in for appointments and getting spoiled with treats, love, and attention! I trust DVC with my dog's health and recommend them to others!

Our visit was absolutely amazing! It was so wonderful being able to go directly into the exam room and not have to wait in the waiting room with my nervous cat. The vet and nurse both also gave her the space she needed and did their best to make her feel calm and comfortable. We were in and our super quick, which I cannot express how much I appreciate with my cat's temperament! Thank you to all who helped!"

If you are looking for a vet that treats your pets like family, this is it. Dr. Cahill and the entire staff—from the front desk to the medical team—are remarkably compassionate, caring, and knowledgeable.
> As "frequent flyers" at various franchise vets in the past, we know how rare it is to find a clinic this dedicated. They were incredible with our reactive rescue dog Moxie, and provided top-tier care. When our other girl Maizey needed a quick post-surgery checkup, they got her in immediately. They also practice with total honesty, never pushing unnecessary expenses, and even follow up over the phone to see how things are going. We are so grateful we found them!

First, you are independent and not part of the big corp. vet offices, one of which wanted to do an unnecessary operation on an 8 mo. old puppy. So glad we sought you out and got a second opinion. Everyone in the office is knowledgeable and kind. Our Maltipoo was examined and you confirmed our thoughts about treatment. We look forward to a long and happy relationship with you all.
Dr.Priddy and his staff and assistants are always so kind, gentle and loving with our dogs. They are professional and patient. This is the best place to take a pet you love.

Had a wonderful first meeting. Dr Cahill spent lots of time with April and was able to answer all my questions. Even followed up with some additional info via text. There was no waiting and prompt responses to questions."
The vet answered all my questions clearly and treated my cat with care. I felt confident leaving the appointment.

Great vet for my very anxious dog!  My dog, Winnie, has such terrible anxiety and Dr. Cahill was so kind and gentle with her. She really took the time not only to listen to me but also to work at a pace that worked for my dog. The office staff was great too!  When we arrived, they had been told Winnie was anxious and they greeted her accordingly, with kindness and patience. Great clinic. If you have an anxious pet, I highly recommend Dr. Cahill -or even if you have a non anxious pet, :)

We saw the new doctor for a last minute sick visit.  I never received a follow up call from the doctor.  When I called, the receptionist said notes said doctor was to call, but she had not.  The tech called me back to say the doctor was seeing patients.  I asked for lab results and was told the doctor didn't send out labs as she diagnosed in office.  I asked she contact me when she was available.   That never happened.   Our dog was misdiagnosed with CANCER.  After we received treatment elsewhere and the results were sent to DVC, I called again.  I have never had a call back.

UPDATE
Please note that the comments below are not true!  As we NEVER got a call back from Dr. Callahan, she never referred us anywhere.  She recommended an amputation for a cyst.  On my own, NO REFERRAL AS NO CONTACT, I sourced two reputable other opinions.
We were told our our dog had cancer.  We requested testing that was never done.  And when I talked with other staff multiple times, a doctor never called.
I am not surprised by your response as it is typically of the responses on other posts.  Don't take responsibility for your failures, even after admitting on a phone with the coowner/wife  "dropped the ball on this."  And no, I don't need your inconsiderate comments about the doctors I took my dog to when you failed!  That's when I hung up.
I love that you added this post to my dogs records.  I have already shared my experience with the qualified veterinarian  we see now.
Not easy/good to work with, and will nickel and dime you for anything and everything.
They take great care of my pups, treatment and options are clearly outlined so I can make the best decisions about their care.  Friendly staff and vets, I’m glad I found this clinic.

I can not say enough about Dr. Priddy and the team. I have recommended many of my friends to him and his staff; they all love him. He truly cares about your pet. He is smart. And the team is caring and attentive. Going to a privately owned and managed company versus the huge corporate chains. It is night and day. You know as soon as you walk in the door. Best ever!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Priddy and Staff. They are incredibly caring, approachable, and knowledgeable. They take the time to listen, explain everything clearly, and truly treat both pets and owners with compassion.

Y'all always take such good care of my cat Mousse and do your best to make her feel comfortable even though she's very scared of leaving my home. You're very thorough and good at explaining things which makes me feel informed about how to best take care of my cat. Thank you!
They take the time to really understand your pet’s situation and needs. They listen to you and your concerns and give thoughtful advice. I can’t say enough good things about this veterinary practice.
The doctors and staff have always been so friendly and caring
Whoever you are, we hope you have a better day.
They take wonderful care of my daughters dog!

I had a horrible experience with my last vet when I had to euthanize my dog in August of 2024, which ended up with my refusing to go back to them. I was referred to DVC by my trainer of many years when I adopted my dog Nellie in January 2025. As of October 2025, I have had nothing but wonderful experiences with them. They are kind, clearly love animals, and are compassionate. We love the DVC team!
We love it here! I’ve been taking my CavaPoo here since we moved to Dallas! Everyone is amazing and they truly care about their patients
I really love Dallas Veterinary Clinic because they treat Khaos so well and he's always excited to see them as well.❤️

Couldn't have asked for a smoother or better experience during one of the hardest and emotional times possible... Thank you Dallas Veterinary Clinic for helping our family now with 2 dogs and 1 cat over the last 15 years. Highly recommend!

The DVC team is fantastic.  I highly recommend them.  I'm new to the area and they were able to see my dog quickly and even a same day appointment on a subsequent visit when my doggo was sick. The care and effort they make to help everyone feel comfortable and cared for is outstanding.  So glad we found DVC. They really go above and beyond the call of duty.
Great group of vets and vet assistants. They are all helpful and answer any questions you have. Always have a smile on they're faces.
Dr. Priddy has a great bedside manner, seems smart/intuitive, first place my anxious dog did not shake, kind staff, only did what was necessary, very clean facility
The truly love their patients!   So kind and gentle.

Dr. Priddy has been taking care of everything concerning my frenchie Tito for the last seven years and i couldn't be more pleased.  The supporting staff is amazing always fitting us in the schedule when last minute issues come up!  You can trust your pets well being with them!
Hi Nestor, thanks for the positive review! We always love seeing you and Lucky, thanks for your loyalty over the years and your kindness!

I am so disappointed with the lack of care and empathy I received from the woman who answered the phone this morning, I think her name was Jessie, when I called about an urgent situation with my dog. I have been going to this vet for the last couple of years, have spent a lot of time and money at this vet for both of my dogs, and I was shocked when this person responded to my situation the way she did. We love Dr. Parker and I’m sure the other vets are just as great but we will be taking our business elsewhere because of this person alone. I highly recommend having anyone other than Jessie answer the phones as she is clearly not trained to deal with people in distress about their animals.

The staff and Dr. Priddy are very kind. A very relaxing an nice environment for animals and humans. I recently switched vets because all the ones I have previously used have all been bought by private equity. It's personally important to me that the clinic I frequent be locally owned preferably by the main Dr. running the practice. I believe this makes for a better overall relationship with the animals and client.

The staff are always so friendly, informative and relaxing. Even when I'm fearing the worst I know they will tell me what needs to be said in a caring and compassionate way. This is why I've been a returning client for multiple years despite living further and further away.

Clinic staff were really courteous and caring. The clinic in general was nice and quiet, clean and cozy. There was a little sound machine going for soothing/calming atmosphere. Dr. Priddy was so gentle and caring too. Our appointment was late in the day so not sure if this calm and quiet atmosphere is typical for the clinic but I am pleased that the staff was working hard to make the experience not so unpleasant for a slightly anxious feline patient. Thank you!

I can’t say enough great things about our first visit to DVC! Dr. Parker and staff were so kind and understanding. They made an effort to help my dog feel more relaxed and excited before proceeding with this exam, and this effort helped him relax and tamped down his usual vet related anxiety. He was comfortable throughout the rest of his visit! I am so appreciative of the incredible level of care he received at DVC. We will definitely be back for future visits!

As a certified dog behavior consultant with the IAABC I am always looking for primary care providers who are trained in low-stress handling and have an understanding of how medical and behavior are intertwined. I have referred many behavior cases to DVC for work-ups and can't count how many times they've been able to uncover things that other clinics missed.

Additionally, I began to take my own dog, Seven, here for his routine care. He is very fearful of strangers and has had a negative history in the clinic setting, but Dr. Parker and Jessie have been willing to go slow and earn his trust over time. They are flexible and suggest creative ideas beyond what a traditional vet may be willing to do. They make the logistics of appointments and payments very easy, too!

I am SO grateful to have found DVC for my own dogs and for my clients!

I moved to Dallas for law school and was looking for a new veterinarian.

My dog has always been very afraid of the vet trying to hide in the corners and get away from them when he was getting his check ups.

When I was looking into vets in Dallas, I saw that this veterinarian office stated that it had a fear free practice. I read the reviews and saw that many clients stated how patient and kind the veterinarians were with their pets.

Taking my dog here was truly such an amazing experience. My dog is not friendly with other animals, and the staff always made sure that he was not in a room or waiting area with other dogs or cats around. We were always taken into a room very quickly upon our arrival.

Every time we went to the vets office, the vet veterinarians would sit on the floor with him and wait for him to come to them instead of forcing him to allow them to check his ears or give him a shot.

The whole staff was so patient with him and always made sure to give him a lot of treats during his visit. I never felt pressured into any kind of procedure for my pet and they always worked with the budget that I had.

We made many appointments with this veterinarian because he was suffering with allergy problems, which we finally got under control after years of trying back home. My dog did not have any fear walking into the veterinarians office and happily greeted the doctors and other staff.

I have moved away from Dallas, but miss this practice dearly. I recommend them to everybody. I know that has an animal in Dallas, Texas. I am thankful for them for having so much patience with my dog and for always working with me to make sure he was healthy and happy.

Rico misses you all! Thanks for everything.
Thanks for the great feedback Molly! We would love to hear what you enjoy about our practice if you wish to share. 😊  …
We have taken all of our pets here for years and always appreciate the care given by the DVC team! Our dogs and cats feel comfortable at each visit!
They have a very comforting atmosphere and take extremely care of our pet!
Best vet in Dallas.

Dallas Veterinary Clinic has taken care of all 3 of our dogs over a span of 3 to over 10 years. The staff loves our dogs and helps us keep our dogs healthy. We trust the staff with our dogs and our dogs love visiting the staff and actually love getting their check ups here. We love it so much we moved and still drive 45 min or more for our border collie and Aussie to recieve their care.
Dr. Priddy & Dr. Parker and staff ARE THE best! Wouldn't go anywhere else and they love my Archie!
We are new to DVC and are so very happy we found them. They have been so kind, helpful and patient. The office environment is very calm.

I went in for a first time visit with my rescue puppy earlier this week and thought this vet was amazing! My dog loved all the attention and treats she received, and we even got a puppy gift bag! Everyone we talked to there was super nice and seemed to really care about the health and wellbeing of my dog. They were able to answer all of my questions during our visit, and I left feeling a lot better than when I went in! I am so glad we found this vet, and I will definitely be recommending them to everyone I know!!!

I cannot say enough about DVC!!! They are always SO kind and thorough with my sweet fur baby. I have a large Bernese Mtn Dog who used to be terrified of the vet. When I moved to Dallas I started coming here & my dog has gone from having to …

I've been bringing my cats here forever.  They are rescue kitties and the staff, Dr. Priddy and Dr. Parker are terrific.  They are 8 years old now and doing great. Also, my cats are pretty chill when they come.

I love this vet clinic. The atmosphere is calm and both veterinarians are wonderful. The staff is great too. The clinic is "fear free" certified, so all of our visits are held with the vet sitting on the ground with my dog, lots of treats …

We have been overly pleased with both Drs Priddy and Parker. The entire staff is wonderful. The attention to detail, compassion, cleanliness, ease of scheduling/records access, patience & knowledge when answering questions etc is always top …

My dogs, Calliope and Hagrid love going to the clinic. They don’t even notice their shots because they are too busy getting cuddles. The staff is friendly, professional, caring. Absolutely the best vet clinic I’ve ever been to and I’ve lived in 4 states and had numerous fur babies over the past 60 years!
